audience: managers and freelancers who track their team's or their own time in DeskTime

useCases.title: See the team's tracked time for one day
useCases.text: With an admin key, list the team's tracked time for one day, page by page. Then read one employee's day summary.

useCases.title: Review one employee's projects or apps for a day
useCases.text: Read one employee's day with its projects and tasks, or with its apps and websites. Ask for one day at a time.

useCases.title: List active projects and the work schedule
useCases.text: List the active projects with their tasks, one page at a time. Read the company's work schedule and timezone.

useCases.title: Create a project and run its timer
useCases.text: Create a project with an optional first task. Then start or stop the timer on it for the key's user. Starting can switch off the running project.
